items.a: Yes. Vantro holds an Australian wagering licence and offers sports and racing betting, which is permitted online. Online casino games are not offered in Australia.
Most PayID withdrawals arrive in about an hour. Bank transfers can take up to one business day.

items.q: Which payment methods can I use?
items.a: PayID, BPAY, Visa and Mastercard debit cards and Apple Pay. Credit cards cannot be used for online betting in Australia.

items.q: Do I need to verify my identity?
items.a: Yes. Australian law requires identity checks before you can bet. Most accounts are verified automatically within minutes.

items.q: How do I set limits or take a break?
items.a: Set deposit limits in your account settings at any time. You can also exclude yourself from all licensed betting providers through BetStop at betstop.gov.au.
